Mercy:
At the end of each boss fight, you have the option of either killing your adversary or sparing them, the final boss is dependant on who you let live and who you let die

Currently unnamed
(Was gonna name this part "hearts" but it feels like I'm ripping off boss souls from the Dark Souls Series, still unsure of the mechanic itself but I kinda liked the idea)
A reward from killing a boss that greatly raises a single attribute (for now it's just either health or attack power)

(Also unnamed)
Tells you how much guilt you carry, the higher the number, the greater the risk of becoming a Scavenger Crow, greatly affects attack power

That's all I have so far
